fr.name: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo

en.name: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo
en.synopsis: Burst right into the feverish puzzle action that combines irresistible, addictive fun with famous Capcom characters. Beat your opponent to the punch by stacking block after block in strategic patterns and color combinations. Be the first to fill the opponent's screen with blocks and K.O. you win! But get ready for more, because you can't play just once.
